rows.name: Hag Claws
rows.description: You gain a +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls with your claws.

rows.name: Surprisingly Tough
rows.description: Your natural armor bonus increases by +1.

rows.name: Uncanny Resistance
rows.description: You gain spell resistance equal to 6 + your character level. %1.|TL+6

rows.name: Brazen
rows.description: You take a -2 penalty on Disguise and Stealth checks but gain fire resistance 5 and a +2 bonus on saves against fire effects.

rows.name: Golden
rows.description: You take a -2 penalty on Disguise and Stealth checks but gain a +2 bonus on saves against blindness, dazzling, patterns, and effects with the light descriptor. When you cast spells or use spell-like abilities that are from the illusion (pattern) subschool or have the light descriptor, you do so at +1 caster level.

rows.name: Silver
rows.description: You take a -2 penalty on Disguise and Stealth checks but gain a +2 bonus on saves against paralysis, petrification, and poison, and your unarmed strikes or natural weapons count as silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

rows.name: Steel
rows.description: You take a -2 penalty on Disguise and Stealth checks but gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC, and your unarmed strikes or natural weapons count as cold iron for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

rows.name: Flare Burst
rows.description: By expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Wake of Light
rows.description: By expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Searing Light
rows.description: By expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Wandering Star Motes
rows.description: By expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Sunbeam
rows.description: By expending a use of daylight, you may use this spell as a spell-like ability.

rows.name: Enhanced Senses
rows.description: If you have low-light vision, you gain the scent catfolk racial trait. If you have the scent racial trait, you gain low-light vision.

rows.name: Fast Sprinter
rows.description: You gain a 10-foot racial bonus to your speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw actions. If you have the sprinter racial trait, your racial bonus to speed when using the charge, run, or withdraw action increases to a 20-foot bonus.

rows.name: Sharp Claws
rows.description: If you do not have the cat's claws racial trait or the claws of the beast manifestation from the Aspect of the Beast feat , you gain the cat's claws racial trait. If you have either the cat's claws racial trait or the claws of the beast manifestation, your claw damage increases to 1d6.
